instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Commercial property management firm operating 12 office buildings, 3 retail centers, and 2 logistics parks totaling 120,000 m² of leasable area. Managing 400+ tenant relationships. Seeking to implement IoT-based building energy management and a tenant experience mobile app. Operate from 2-3 locations or departments. We have some budget headroom for experimentation but look for quick wins that can demonstrate value within 6 months before committing to longer-term programs. The leadership team is aligned on the need to modernize but debates where to start.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.

fields.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 5 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Develop Adjacent Service Lines and New Business Models
opportunities.rationale: The current dependence on the top three clients (55% of revenue) presents an unacceptable concentration risk. The focus must shift from merely optimizing existing services to generating entirely new, scalable revenue streams by leveraging core real estate data and management expertise for adjacent markets or geographies.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated Business Model Innovation Task Force (cross-functional: sales, operations, finance).
Conduct a deep dive market analysis into under-served B2B segments (e.g., specialized logistics park management or vertical farming infrastructure).
Develop a minimum viable product (MVP) proposal for the highest potential new revenue stream.
resources_needed: External consulting expertise in adjacent markets.
Dedicated time allocation from senior leadership/sales teams.
execution_plan.success_metric: Identification and feasibility scoring of 3 viable, non-core business units capable of generating >10% revenue within 2 years.
milestones: Task force charter approved and staffed (Month 1).
Top 3 potential new markets identified and prioritized (Month 2).
Investment thesis for chosen market drafted (Month 4).

opportunities.title: Implement Smart Building Energy Management Systems (IoT)
opportunities.rationale: Building energy efficiency is a high-value, quick-win offering that directly appeals to modern tenants and addresses rising operational costs. Utilizing existing data warehouse infrastructure makes this an efficient extension of current digital efforts.

first_actions: Pilot IoT sensors/data collection in one medium-sized building (Proof of Concept).
Integrate real-time energy consumption data into the existing BI dashboard.
Develop a tiered service package based on savings metrics for marketing.
execution_plan.success_metric: Demonstrable average energy reduction of 12-15% in the pilot building within 6 months, leading to a signed service contract.
milestones: Pilot scope definition and vendor selection (Month 1).
Data pipeline established and initial dashboard visualization complete (Month 3).
Case study finalized and sales pitch ready (Month 5).

next_steps.action: Formalize and launch the Business Model Innovation Task Force with clear KPIs focused on diversification.
Identify 2-3 anchor clients willing to participate in the IoT pilot program for immediate proof-of-concept testing.
Update employee training modules (Culture/Talent) to emphasize revenue generation through new services, rather than just cost reduction via automation.

key_weaknesses: Over-dependence on top 3 clients (Strategic Concentration Risk).
Siloed view of digital assets: Strong process automation capacity is not yet fully leveraged for new revenue generation.
Cultural resistance to radical change, despite leadership alignment and existing successful initiatives.

improvements: Successfully implemented foundational digital infrastructure (Cloud ERP, Data Warehouse, BI).
Established a Center of Excellence (COE) for automation (RPA/Low-code), demonstrating scalable cost savings.
Increased operational visibility through data integration and process standardization.
persistent_gaps: The strategic shift from 'efficiency' to 'diversification' requires deeper buy-in beyond the executive team.
Lack of established internal mechanism for continuous, structured business model experimentation.
Operational resilience remains vulnerable due to lack of diversified revenue bases.
achieved_milestones: Completion of ERP migration to cloud platform.
Rollout and utilization of self-service BI dashboards across departments.
Delivery of €2.4M in annualized cost savings through automation programs.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has substantially matured its operational and digital foundations (ERP migration, Data Warehouse setup) and successfully demonstrated cost efficiencies via RPA/COE. However, the core strategic challenge—diversification away from client concentration—remains critical and requires a more aggressive shift in focus.
